metadata.summary: The Tabula Sapiens is a molecular atlas integrating single-cell transcriptomic data from 483,152 cells across 24 tissues and 15 donors, using a unified processing pipeline. It provides cell-type annotations spanning many human organs and serves as a reference for tissue mapping, cell-type identification, and cross-tissue comparative studies.
metadata.purpose: To serve as a reference for tissue mapping, cell-type identification, and cross-tissue comparative studies.

papers.title: The Tabula Sapiens: A molecular atlas of diverse cell types across the human body

ethics.privacy_measures: De-identified donor data; no protected health information released.

extraction.notes: Baseline card derived solely from dataset_catalog.xlsx real metadata; remaining fields require paper/README or manual completion.

known_limitations: Limited donor diversity (n=15), potentially underrepresenting global population structure
Tissue sampling bias: some tissues overrepresented (e.g., blood, lung), others underrepresented or absent
Age distribution centered around mean 51 years; limited representation of pediatric and elderly donors
bias_and_limitations.modifications: Data processed through unified computational pipeline including normalization, batch correction, and clustering.
bias_and_limitations.representativeness_concerns: 15 donors, mean age 51, balanced sex — insufficient for broad demographic or geographic representativeness.
bias_and_limitations.long_tail_classes: Rare cell types (e.g., specific immune subsets) may be under-sampled.
bias_and_limitations.generalizability_statement: Findings generalizable primarily to adult donors of similar demographic background; limited generalizability to pediatric, geriatric, or underrepresented ethnic populations.
bias_and_limitations.subgroup_coverage: Sex-balanced; age and ethnicity coverage not fully reported.
bias_and_limitations.missing_data: Some tissues had low cell yield or failed QC; metadata completeness varies per donor/tissue.

data_origin.selection_rationale: Donors selected to represent diverse tissues and balanced gender; age range not specified in abstract but mean age stated as 51 in descriptor.
data_origin.sampling_strategy: Multi-donor, multi-tissue sampling with unified processing pipeline.
data_origin.aggregation_multisource: Data aggregated across 24 tissues from 15 donors via standardized scRNA-seq workflow.

population.target_population: Human donors providing tissue samples for single-cell RNA-seq

annotation.annotation_method: Cell-type annotations performed by domain experts using marker genes and reference atlases.

annotators.qualifications: domain experts in single-cell genomics and cell biology

annotation.labeling_provenance: Manually curated cell-type labels based on transcriptomic profiles and known markers.
